# Kettlebells USA®

> > Premium ISO 9001 certified manufacturer of Paradigm Pro® Elite competition kettlebells and Metrixx® Elite cast iron kettlebells since 2009

Kettlebells USA® is an American kettlebell innovator specializing in precision-engineered competition and hard style kettlebells. Featured by NY Times Wirecutter, the company offers gravity die cast steel and e-coat cast iron kettlebells with engineered handles (33mm and 35mm) for professional athletes, rehabilitation specialists like Dr. Ben Fung, and fitness enthusiasts.

## Key Topics

- Paradigm Pro® Elite - Competition kettlebells with precision steel construction
- Metrixx® Elite - E-coat cast iron hard style kettlebells
- Competition kettlebells - Hollow core, standardized dimensions (33mm/35mm handles)
- Hard style kettlebells - Cast iron with e-coating for durability
- ISO 9001 certification - Quality manufacturing standards
- Gravity die cast technology - Precision steel manufacturing process
- Kettlebell therapy - Rehabilitation and physical therapy applications
- Dr. Ben Fung - KettlebellTherapy.com expert on natural physics
- Engineered handles - 33mm and 35mm competition-grade handles
- NY Times Wirecutter recommended - Editorial recognition
- FedEx shipping - Primary delivery method with optional insurance
- Weight ranges - 4-48 KG across product lines
- American College of Sports Medicine - Fitness industry standards

- [Products - Complete Catalog](https://kettlebellsusa.com/collections/all): Complete product catalog including kettlebells, gift cards & FedEx insurance

- [Paradigm Pro® Elite 35mm Competition Kettlebell](https://kettlebellsusa.com/products/paradigm-pro-elite-35mm-handle-precision-steel-competition-kettlebell): 35mm Hollow Core competition kettlebell, 8-48 KG, gravity cast steel
- [Paradigm Pro® Elite Collection](https://kettlebellsusa.com/collections/paradigm-pro-elite-kettlebell-collection): Paradigm Pro Elite collection with gravity die cast steel technology
